validateRequiredFields(ownerFieldsDto);
validatePostcode(ownerFieldsDto.getPostcode(), ownerFieldsDto.getCity());
Owner owner = ownerMapper.toOwner(ownerFieldsDto);
owner.setAddress(normalizeAddress(ownerFieldsDto.getAddress()));
effectiveDate = registrationDate ?? LocalDate.now();
owner.setRegistrationDate(toBusinessDay(effectiveDate));
rejectWhenDailyLimitReached(owner.getRegistrationDate());
rejectWhenCityAtCapacity(owner.getCity());
applyHousehold(owner);
owner.setTelephone(normalizeTelephone(...));
owner.setEmail(normalizeEmail(...));
rejectDuplicateIdentity(owner);
owner.setCustomerCode(nextCustomerCode(city, lastName));
owner.setMembershipNumber(membershipNumber(customerCode, registrationDate));
owner.setNamesakeCount(countNamesakes(firstName, lastName));
this.clinicService.saveOwner(owner);
OwnerDto dto = ownerMapper.toOwnerDto(owner);

- `address`: `@NotNull @Size(min=1,max=255)`
- `city`: `@NotNull @Size(min=1,max=80)`
- `telephone`: `@NotNull @Size(min=1,max=20)`

7. `membershipNumber` — `membershipNumber` (206–208): `<customerCode>-M<YY>`.
8. `namesakeCount` — `countNamesakes` (219–224): count of existing owners with same first+last name.
9. DB save of the new owner — `clinicService.saveOwner(owner)`.
10. Audit logging — dedicated SLF4J logger named `"AUDIT"` (line 84) emits `owner created id=… customerCode=… registrationDate=… membershipLevel=…` (lines 171–173) after a successful save.
11. Response mapping — `ownerMapper.toOwnerDto` computes derived response-only fields (see below).
12. `Location` header set to `/api/owners/{id}`, returns 201.

Response-only derivations in the mapper `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/mapper/OwnerMapper.java` (`toOwnerDto`, lines 35–158): `displayName`, `initials`, `membershipLevel` (1–3, +1 for email, +1 for no namesakes), `locality` (region from postcode else city), `bulkSignupWarning` (true when >80 other owners share the registrationDate), `contactPreference` (EMAIL if email present else PHONE), `identityKey`. ### 5. Service and persistence layer

- Impl: `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/service/ClinicServiceImpl.java`:
  - `saveOwner` (lines 232–237): `@Transactional`, delegates to `ownerRepository.save(owner)`.
  - `findAllOwners` (lines 126–129): `@Transactional(readOnly=true)`, `ownerRepository.findAll()`. (Called many times per create — by each of the reject/count/household helpers and the mapper.)
- Repository (jpa profile): `/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/repository/jpa/JpaOwnerRepositoryImpl.java` — `save` (92–100): `em.persist` if id null else `em.merge`. There are also `jdbc` profile impls under `repository/jdbc/`.

### 6. Owner entity + validation + lifecycle hooks

`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Owner.java`:
- `@Entity @Table(name="owners")`, extends `Person`.
- Field constraints: `address @NotEmpty`, `city @NotEmpty`, `telephone @NotEmpty @Pattern(regexp="^\\+[0-9]{8,15}$", message="Telephone must be in E.164 form…")`. `postcode`, `email`, `registrationDate`, `customerCode`, `membershipNumber`, `householdId`, `namesakeCount` have no validation. `pets` is `@OneToMany(cascade=ALL, mappedBy="owner", fetch=EAGER)`.
- `Person` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/Person.java`): `firstName @NotEmpty`, `lastName @NotEmpty`, `@MappedSuperclass`.
- `BaseEntity` (`/home/daniel/sandbox/src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/model/BaseEntity.java`): `@Id @GeneratedValue(strategy=IDENTITY)`, `isNew()`.
- Lifecycle hooks: NONE. There are no `@PrePersist`/`@PreUpdate`/`@PostLoad` or `@EntityListeners` on `Owner`, `Person`, or `BaseEntity`. All defaulting/derivation happens in the controller, not entity callbacks. (Note the entity's `@Pattern` on telephone is only enforced if a bean-validation provider validates the entity on persist; the controller pre-normalizes telephone to satisfy it.)
